scope: new experimental candidate; preserve prior soft-mixture results; no current P9 production activation
cases: same 18 previously consumed cases as p10-online-response-mixture-development-20260914; no new seed or holdout

candidate.before_gate: untried targets use exactly 12.75 for their first slot
candidate.after_gate: untried targets use the posterior-weighted conditional mean response
candidate.tried_target: always use the target's own public first response with published turn decay
candidate.censoring: responses at an opinion bound or starting outside [-100,100] do not update likelihood

required_results: paired final score and win/tie/loss by consumed response stratum
gate activation action and posterior weights
number of pre-gate decisions protected from soft posterior movement
action failures, budget, public observation and action-log hashes
interpretation: measure whether the fixed warm-up removes transient independent-distribution losses while retaining genuine aligned/inverse terminal gain; consumed data cannot qualify production
module_boundary: public response ledger lives in an independent starnet.policy module, has no environment or Blackboard access, and is injected into planners as a response callable
